title: Jalen Brunson: The Clutch Conductor
imageHint: The steady point guard in Knicks blue and orange, orchestrating plays with calm precision in pressure moments
description: From Villanova champion to Dallas role player to New York's franchise cornerstone, Jalen Brunson has proven that basketball IQ and clutch performance matter more than athletic measurables.

questions.question: Which NBA team did Jalen Brunson sign with in 2022 as a free agent, leaving the Dallas Mavericks?
questions.explanation: Brunson signed a 4-year, $104 million contract with the New York Knicks in 2022, immediately becoming their starting point guard and team leader.

questions.question: How many NCAA Championships did Jalen Brunson win at Villanova University?
questions.explanation: Brunson won NCAA Championships with Villanova in 2016 and 2018, earning Most Outstanding Player honors in the 2018 tournament for his clutch performances.

questions.question: What position did Jalen Brunson's father, Rick Brunson, play during his NBA career?
questions.explanation: Rick Brunson was an NBA point guard who played for nine teams during his career, including the Knicks. His basketball knowledge greatly influenced Jalen's development.

questions.question: In the 2022 playoffs with Dallas, Brunson had a breakout performance against which Western Conference team, averaging over 21 points per game?
questions.explanation: Brunson averaged 21.6 points per game against Utah in the 2022 first round, showcasing the clutch gene that would make him a coveted free agent that summer.

questions.question: What specific advanced basketball metric improved dramatically for Brunson after joining the Knicks, reflecting his increased usage and efficiency?
questions.explanation: Brunson's usage rate jumped from 22% in Dallas to over 28% with the Knicks, reflecting his evolution from role player to primary offensive initiator while maintaining high efficiency.
